ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low contrast ratio; high-density of low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) dominant across >95% of the visible surface with sparse, isolated high-intensity pixels associated with distal tip anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes; secondary grey-tone mottling observed localized to the interior lower-left quadrant of the left fluke lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped indentation; estimated interior angle of approximately 140 degrees with a shallow bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serration across the primary trailing edge boundary; topography transition to high-amplitude irregular jaggedness at the far distal tips due to biological protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature on both lobes, sweeping from the median notch toward the distal tips; right lobe appears slightly more elongated in the 2D plane projection.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, light-colored (off-white/beige) irregular circular pixel groups localized on the outer distal margins of both fluke tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of calcified, high-contrast organisms (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal edges, significantly distorting the natural linear contour of the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric trailing edge profile where the right distal tip exhibits a larger volumetric cluster of high-intensity protrusions compared to the left.
